products.title: Skechers Recovery Series 1.0 Mattress in a Box
products.seoTitle: Skechers Recovery Series 1.0 Mattress | Medium & Plush
products.seoDescription: Explore the Skechers Recovery Series 1.0 Mattress in a Box. Available in Medium and Plush comfort options with 10.5-inch and 11-inch profiles.
products.descriptionHtml:
Slip into comfort day and night with the Skechers Recovery Series 1.0 Mattress in a Box, powered by Serta innovation. The brochure highlights breathable comfort, cooling fabric, cozy quilting, and supportive cushioning.

Key Features

  • Breathable Cover — A soft, breathable cover helps you rest and wake refreshed.
  • CoolFeel Plus Fabric — Engineered with cooling performance technologies to keep you cool and comfortable.
  • Skechers CozyFit Quilt Design — Soft, cozy material for all-night comfort.
  • Skechers Air-Cooled Memory Foam — Instant comfort and pressure relief.
  • Skechers Max Cushioning — Featuring up to 6X more Air-Cooled Memory Foam compared to Series 1.0 and 2.0 models.
  • BestEdge Foam Encasement — Lasting, edge-to-edge mattress stability.
  • 8" Custom Support Coil System — Provides durable support and minimizes motion transfer.
  • Skechers Arch Fit Coil Support — Supportive cushioning system for enhanced comfort. Features 920 coil density in a queen-size mattress.
  • Skechers Arch Fit Plus Coil Support — Supportive cushioning system for maximum comfort. Features 1000 coil density in a queen-size mattress.

Part of the Skechers collection powered by Serta innovation. The brochure states that the collection is made in the U.S.A. with global components, CertiPUR-US® certified, and compatible with adjustable bases.
